hint_ladder: Say that people are being made to notice an issue.
Use raise, not rise, because the verb takes awareness as its object, and of follows it.
Start with the words: The campaign aims to raise ___ of mental health.
teaching_content.reveal_form: The campaign aims to raise awareness of mental health.
canonical_forms: The campaign aims to raise awareness of mental health.
alternative_realizations: The film raised awareness of the problem.
